title: k11 Release Readiness Agent
description:
Claude Code plugin that answers 'can we ship this branch?': it plans the checks a change needs, gathers evidence in parallel sub-agents using six open-source MCP servers (Playwright QA, Selenium QA, API Contract QA, API Functional QA, LLM Assure and Release Gate), and returns the Release Gate's deterministic, evidence-backed verdict.

Source code: https://github.com/K11-Software-Solutions/k11techlab-release-readiness-agent
